About Zixlab

Experience turned into useful products.

Zixlab Ltd develops practical digital tools and engineered products shaped by decades of hands-on engineering, maintenance and problem-solving experience.

Our story

Start with the problem. Engineer the right answer.

Zixlab was founded to turn worthwhile ideas into products that work clearly, reliably and purposefully in the real world.

Our perspective comes from more than three decades in engineering, including experience with pharmaceutical manufacturing, quality-critical equipment, automation, maintenance and technical improvement.

That background shapes how we develop products: understand the task, remove unnecessary complexity, test thoroughly and keep improving. PharmaScan is the first Zixlabs digital product to follow that approach.

Based in Ellesmere, Shropshire, Zixlab Ltd is the company behind the Zixlabs product brand.

Our approach

Three principles behind every Zixlab product.

Strong products come from sound engineering judgement, clear communication and disciplined development.

Practical
